title: The Exclusion Ratchet: False-Positive Suppression Accumulates and Persists in Detection Rule Repositories
abstract: arXiv:2608.31062v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a rule produces too many false alarms an analyst adds an exclusion, and the rule thereafter declines to alert in that circumstance. Each such decision is locally reasonable; what becomes of them collectively is not known. Recent longitudinal work established that curation does not converge, but measured restoration time only for revisions that were later reverted -- a measure silent about narrowing that is never undone. We measure that. Across nine years and 8,234 revisions of the SigmaHQ corpus we detect suppression semantically -- growth in the set of predicates held under negation without compensating growth in coverage -- and validate it against blinded hand labelling (precision 0.828, recall 0.911). The test is deterministic: nothing is learned from the data, and the definitions are released as code. Exclusions were added 1,642 times and withdrawn 304, a ratio of 5.4 to 1 that rises to 13 to 1 at the level of the individual r

translated_title: 排除棘轮：误报抑制在检测规则仓库中的累积与持久化
translated_abstract: 当一条规则产生过多误报时，分析师会添加一条排除条件，此后该规则在该情形下便不再告警。每一个这样的决定在局部都是合理的，但它们共同产生的效果却不得而知。近期的纵向研究表明规则维护并不会收敛，但仅测量了后来被回滚的修订版本的恢复时间——这一度量无法反映那些从未被撤销的检测范围收窄。我们测量了这一点。在 SigmaHQ 语料库九年间共 8,234 次修订中，我们从语义上检测抑制行为——即被否定谓词集合的增长而没有相应的覆盖范围补偿性增长——并通过盲法人工标注对其进行验证（精确率 0.828，召回率 0.911）。该测试是确定性的：不从数据中学习任何东西，且相关定义以代码形式发布。排除条件被添加 1,642 次，被撤销仅 304 次，比率为 5.4 比 1，而在单个规则层面这一比率升至 13 比 1。
tldr: 该论文提出一种确定性的语义检测方法，首次量化了检测规则仓库中排除条件的“棘轮效应”——在 SigmaHQ 语料库九年 8,234 次修订中，排除条件添加与撤销之比高达 5.4:1（单规则层面达 13:1），证明误报抑制会持续累积且几乎不可逆。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a deterministic semantic detection method and, for the first time, quantifies the "ratchet effect" of exclusions in detection rule repositories—across nine years and 8,234 revisions of the SigmaHQ corpus, exclusions were added versus withdrawn at a ratio of 5.4:1 (rising to 13:1 per rule), demonstrating that false-positive suppression accumulates and persists almost irreversibly.
